name: platform-guardian
description: Single entry point for Ono employees in Claude Code: opens every session with a git-hygiene check against the project's central branch, asks what you're working on (bug, feature, QA), routes you into the right Ono plugin process, closes the session without forcing a commit or PR (those come when the work is finished), lists PRs waiting for your review, and welcomes first-time users with an interactive onboarding tour.
